description: We cannot go back to the days when someone could be denied coverage because of a pre-existing condition or when you could be charged more for coverage for simply being a woman. That’s why I have consistently voted to protect the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and build on it. I support getting America to universal quality coverage and the best way to incentivize competition is to give people a choice between public and private coverage options.
